items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I heard - I felt this bass drum. This was Mr. Emil Helmicke, the greatest bass drum player that ever lived... The last time I saw him Max Roach Art Blakey, he was 86 years old.

ctx.x: So Aunt Mattie took you to the circus when you were a little boy?
I heard - I felt this bass drum. This was Mr. Emil Helmicke, the greatest bass drum player that ever lived. He was the highest paid man -
